[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also recommended for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma excision should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma tumor.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral skin, and genitalia.",
  "The primary excision recommendation has a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21)."
]
